sources.finding: Official catalog lists 15-year as latest primary timing release. The downloaded alternate narrowband reduction shares the 2013-2020 Arecibo span; older NG releases are not independent new epochs.

CPTA catalog describes June 2019-September 2022 FAST observations, but its public access link and data type identify polarization profiles (112 files, 11.37 MB). No usable J1453 time-of-arrival series acquired here.

Official single-pulsar noise supplement metadata lists one plots_spna.zip archive (90,387,588 bytes). Metadata saved locally; archive contents not inspected. No directly exposed PAR/TIM files verified.
CPTA noise paper points to the Zenodo supplementary material. Further access to calibrated J1453 timing epochs remains an acquisition task.
Older three-year timing study remains a possible archival lead; no machine-readable TOA series acquired during this bounded review.

next_data_requirement: Calibrated FAST or other-observatory J1453 TOAs, uncertainties, timing model and noise information. Inspect epoch overlap; freeze prediction before testing newly acquired data.
